a.lede: The Drupal security team has confirmed that a critical vulnerability that lets attackers hijack unpatched sites has been actively exploited since at least Thursday. [...]
a.title: Hackers now exploit critical Drupal RCE flaw to hijack sites

b.lede: A zero-day vulnerability in the Cacti network monitoring platform has been publicly disclosed, along with a proof-of-concept exploit that lets unauthenticated attackers execute commands on vulnerable servers. [...]
b.title: Unpatched Cacti zero-day with public PoC gives remote code execution
